steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the scenario.
Allow adding the vendor during event creation.
Switch the initial single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Verify the product's automatically filled variant.
Add the named vendor participant required for publishing.
Open the Schedule Event drawer from the footer schedule chip.
Choose the one-hour duration corresponding to the requested 60-minute change.
Close the drawer without pressing Save Schedule.
Assert the footer still shows the default 30-minute duration after the unsaved change was discarded.
Publish the event; the publish confirmation is handled by the domain step.
Assert that the event was successfully published with the default schedule.
